A great morning routine sets a positive, energized tone for the entire day. Begin by waking up at a consistent time and resisting the urge to check your phone. Instead, drink a large glass of water to rehydrate your body after sleep. Follow this with ten minutes of light stretching, yoga, or a brief walk to wake up your muscles and get your blood flowing. 

Next, dedicate a few moments to mindfulness, whether through meditation, deep breathing, or journaling your goals and gratitude. Enjoy a nourishing breakfast paired with a hot cup of tea or coffee without digital distractions. Finally, take a refreshing shower and review your daily schedule, ensuring you step out the door feeling calm, focused, and ready to conquer whatever lies ahead.
